exact_statement: For k >= 3, let F_k(n) be the minimum number of colours needed to colour an n-vertex graph with floor(n^2/4)+1 edges so that every C_(2k+1) is rainbow. For k=3, prove or refute that F_3(n) is asymptotic to n^2/8.
scope_notes: Round-two warm restart from commit ab4b524; typed A/B rank counterexamples are inherited evidence.
Global closure requires an actual conversion theorem from owned A structure to outer-A slack or new B reserve, joined to every hard branch with an explicit 1/8 consequence.
Any scalar addition of A and B capacities is forbidden unless an injective conversion map or owned slack atomization is constructed.
